caption: The drawing depicts a garden scene featuring a variety of objects and structures. In the foreground, there is an ornate pale blue or gray metal fence with decorative patterns, partially intertwined with a flowering plant that has reddish-pink blossoms. To the right, there is a tall post topped with the sculpted head of a horse. Behind the fence, there is a path curving through green grass, leading to a round fountain at the center of the composition; the fountain is topped with a large white or light gray statue of a crane with one wing raised. To the right of the fountain, there is an empty, decorative white metal chair placed on the lawn. Further back, near the center-right, a deer with a tan-brown body and antlers stands near several large trees. The background features a two-story, pale-colored Victorian-style house with intricate woodwork and a balcony, surrounded by more greenery and trees. The overall color palette consists mainly of greens, grays, and blues, with some ochre tones in the deer and muted pinks in the flowers, set under a softly lit sky.
title: Garden Setting
